headline: Argentina Country Risk Hits 2026 High at 777 Points
summary: Argentina's country risk indicator climbed to 777 points, marking a new high for the year, as dollar-denominated bonds fell an average of 1%.
why: Sovereign risk spreads reflect investor confidence in a nation's fiscal stability and debt servicing capacity.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Rising country risk and falling bond prices directly indicate deteriorating sovereign debt valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A drop in dollar bonds pushed the JP Morgan risk indicator to its highest level since late 2025.
